title: Oct 7 Results + Oct 8 Preview: When the Underdogs Have Their Day
summary: A tough 1-3 night on Oct 7, but here's what we learned for tomorrow's slate

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About Tough Nights

Some days the baseball gods just aren't with you. October 7th was one of those nights where we went 1-3, and honestly? It stings a little. But that's the beautiful, maddening thing about this game—it keeps you humble.

## How the Night Unfolded

We had four picks yesterday, all hovering right around that 50-54% confidence range—which tells you everything. These were close calls, coin flips almost. The Dodgers came through for us in Atlanta, but the Sox, Yankees, and Padres all let us down. Not because they didn't try, but because baseball happened.

## The Silver Lining

You know what's interesting? Even on a 1-3 night, we learn something. Those razor-thin margins—50%, 51%, 52%—they're telling us the matchups were genuinely close. We weren't wildly off base; the games just broke the other way. That's October baseball for you.

The Dodgers win at least shows our model can identify opportunities even in tight spots. We'll take that momentum forward.

## Looking Ahead to October 8

Here's where it gets interesting. Tomorrow we're back at it with the Guardians visiting the White Sox again. Yes, the same matchup that didn't go our way yesterday. But this time we've got different pitchers, different circumstances, and a fresh slate.

content.title: ⭐ Tomorrow's Top Pick - Oct 8
content.sub: 50% win probability · Parker Messick vs Hagen Smith

content.value:
## The Matchup to Watch

Parker Messick takes the mound for Cleveland while Hagen Smith gets the ball for Chicago. It's another tight one at 50%—essentially a toss-up—but we're leaning toward the White Sox at home.

The pitching matchup is what makes this compelling. Smith has shown flashes of brilliance at home, and while Messick is solid, this feels like a spot where Chicago can steal one back after we missed on them yesterday.

## Final Thoughts

Look, a 1-3 night isn't what anyone wants to see. But we're not here to pretend every day is perfect. We're here to be honest with you, learn from what the data tells us, and come back stronger.

Tomorrow's another day, another chance. The White Sox are our play, and while it's close, we like our chances with Smith on the mound.

Let's bounce back together. ⚾

author: Hana
